'''2012 Canadian Nationals CL DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[CL]] at [[2012 Canadian Nationals]] (Nationals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Username:''' clepiko
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Nationals
